::: {#sol-best-constant-part2}

At $c = \mean$, the second term is zero,
so the smallest [expected](expectation.qmd#def-expectation) squared error is $\Var{Y}$.

Under squared error,
the best [prediction](expectation.qmd#def-prediction) made without any input is the mean,
and the error that remains is the [variance](#def-variance).
A prediction that uses an input $X$ can improve on $\Var{Y}$
only through how the mean of $Y$ changes with $X$,
which the [conditional expectation function](expectation.qmd#def-cond-expectation-function) describes.

:::
